name: TEMPESTA URSA

specs.notes: Lamborghini's Urus Performante: the 4.0 twin-turbo V8 at 666 CV (490 kW) and 850 N m, eight-speed automatic, permanent four-wheel drive, ~2,150 kg, 0-100 km/h in 3.3 s, 306 km/h (Lamborghini, dealer spec sheets). Its torque curve, ratios and aero are estimates.

garage.blurb: A super-SUV that thinks it's a supercar: 666 horsepower, a tall seat, and it changes direction far better than 2.2 tonnes should.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/urus_p.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
